mapper.select: SELECT version, summary, created_by AS changedBy, created_at AS changedAt, CAST(snapshot AS text) AS snapshot FROM dictionary_history WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND service = #{service} AND dictionary = #{dictionary} AND NOT deleted ORDER BY version DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dictionary_history (id, tenant_id, service, dictionary, version, snapshot, summary, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) SELECT #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{service}, #{dictionary}, COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1, CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb), #{summary}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor} FROM dictionary_history WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND service = #{service} AND dictionary = #{dictionary} AND NOT deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE dictionary_history SET deleted = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT deleted
